co_empire.name: Empire
co_empire.note: Only MP text: climbed through December, 60F in mid-November; no month-naming source for Empire itself (Georgetown guide is a neighbour).

ma_dogtown.name: Dogtown
ma_dogtown.note: No source names months; MP season chart is an image.

wy_valhalla.name: Valhalla
wy_valhalla.note: Ten Sleep system season (sources speak for the whole canyon, not this crag): weighmyrack names May/June and Sept/Oct as great with Jul/Aug workable in shade; MP/guide say Memorial Day to Labor Day busy; mojagear says fall is best; winter/early spring road closed or snowy.

co_bigfoots_the.name: Bigfoots, The
co_bigfoots_the.note: Only road/closure dates (Rampart Range Rd closed ~Dec 1 to Apr/May), which is not a climbing season.

ma_stone_tower_area.name: Stone Tower Area
ma_stone_tower_area.note: No source names months for Lynn Woods bouldering.

va_stones.name: Stones
va_stones.note: No season source found; MP chart not readable.

wy_old_road_crags.name: Old Road Crags
wy_old_road_crags.note: Ten Sleep system season (sources speak for the whole canyon, not this crag): weighmyrack names May/June and Sept/Oct as great with Jul/Aug workable in shade; MP/guide say Memorial Day to Labor Day busy; mojagear says fall is best; winter/early spring road closed or snowy.

az_pinnacle_peak.name: Pinnacle Peak
az_pinnacle_peak.note: Sources say only 'winter' / cool months (rockclimbing.com, a 2001 Oct-Apr hiking quote); no month-naming climbing source.

ca_whitney_portal.name: Whitney Portal
ca_whitney_portal.note: SummitPost names June-October for Whitney Portal climbs; a Lone Pine listing calls it the cooler summer alternative to Alabama Hills; road usually opens ~May 1.

ca_benches_the.name: Benches, The
ca_benches_the.note: MP says only 'spring and fall' for the Emeralds (words, no months); Bowman Rd closed Jan-Mar is access, not season.

il_mississippi_palisades.name: Mississippi Palisades
il_mississippi_palisades.note: Carroll County tourism and SummitPost say spring and fall (words only, no months).

ky_bald_rock_fork_recreational_preserve_.name: Bald Rock Fork Recreational Preserve (BRRP)
ky_bald_rock_fork_recreational_preserve_.note: Reviewer: Red River Gorge system window (round 1, high). Red River Gorge system season: Oct-Nov peak (cabin guide, UKBouldering 'start of Oct to mid-Nov'), a travel guide names May, Jun, Sep, Oct; spring and fall generally; Jul-Aug hot/humid. Months Mar-Apr from 'spring' word only.

ca_rattlesnake_canyon.name: Rattlesnake Canyon
ca_rattlesnake_canyon.note: Joshua Tree/Indian Cove: one guide names early-mid Oct to late Apr/early May; another names Mar-Apr and Oct-Nov as best; joshuatree.guide says fall/spring best; summer off-limits.

nj_mt_tammany.name: Mt. Tammany
nj_mt_tammany.note: No season source; only Minsi falcon closure (Feb-Jul, a different cliff) and 'climbable all year'.

qc_l_amphitheatre.name: L'Amphitheatre
qc_l_amphitheatre.note: SEBKA/tourism pages give no climbing months.

va_back_of_beyond.name: Back of Beyond
va_back_of_beyond.note: Grayson Highlands sources conflict (fall/spring vs summer best); no month-naming source.

wa_deception_crags.name: Deception Crags
wa_deception_crags.note: Guidebook says late spring through early fall, summer most reliable (words only, no months).

wv_south_side_crags_closed.name: South Side Crags (CLOSED)
wv_south_side_crags_closed.note: Closed to climbing; no season applicable.

ak_anchorage_south_central_alaska.name: Anchorage & South Central Alaska
ak_anchorage_south_central_alaska.note: Only a hiking window (Bird Ridge May-Sep) and 'summer'; no climbing-month source.
